mapper.select: SELECT api_id, revision, source, operator_tenant_id, operator_employee_no, recorded_at, history_start, content_digest, digest_version, restored_from_revision FROM catalog_api_revision WHERE environment_id=#{environmentId} AND api_id = #{apiId} ORDER BY revision DESC

SELECT d.* FROM catalog_api_draft d LEFT JOIN catalog_api_revision r ON r.api_id = d.id AND r.revision = d.draft_revision WHERE d.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND r.api_id IS NULL AND d.id IN #{id} ORDER BY d.id
